photos.c: 14 JANUARY 1989 . BASINGSTOKE. Southern Counties "Junior" 'C.C. Darren Mead and Matthew Stickles chase Newham's Julien Gentry for the medals.

Darren Mead ran one of the fastest legs to bring Belgrave into 2nd place in the Reigate Priory relays - despite going off course. Mike Hayes missed the start of the Southern C.C. "Senior" race but worked his way through a large field to finish our top scorer in 85th place.
Below: Bronzed and fit from altutude training in Alberquerque, Darren Mead returned to run a National 12 Stage relay leg of 13:49 - second fastest short stage of the day.
(k – centre) The final league race at Cousdon, 1996-97, with Darren Mead (80) at the head of the field and Gary Staines (81) and Tony Barden in close attendance.
